rules: Signal on day t, bought at the next open, held h sessions, left on a close under the exit line. Lists every five sessions. Price returns before costs.
split: Choices are made on 2017-2021 and read on 2022-2026.

coiled_under_high.what: Within 8% of the 52-week high and 4% of the 60-day high, not yet through it. Ranked on how tight the last fortnight was, how far volume has dried up and how close the price is to the 60-day high.

coiled_leader.what: A market leader (top 30%) within 4% of its 60-day high, with volatility among the most contracted 30%. Ranked on the leader score.

accumulation_near_high.what: Within 8% of the 52-week high. Ranked on how much more volume traded on up days than down days over 50 sessions, and on closeness to the high.

fresh_6m_high.what: First close at a 6-month high in at least 20 sessions, in the last five sessions. Ranked on that day's volume against its usual.

fresh_6m_high_on_volume.what: The same, only where that day's volume was at least 1.5 times its usual.

breakout_from_tight_base.what: A 6-month-high breakout on 1.5 times volume, out of a range that had tightened (ten-day volatility under 85% of its sixty-day). Ranked on how tight.

leader_breakout.what: A market leader (top 30%) that made its first 6-month closing high in 20 sessions, in the last five. Ranked on the leader score.

fresh_52w_high.what: First close at a 52-week high in at least 20 sessions, in the last five. Ranked on the leader score.

fresh_52w_high_on_volume.what: The same, only on 1.5 times volume. Ranked on that day's volume.

breakout_choice.rule: Highest lead over the average stock on 2017-2021 among recipes making eight or more picks a list; taken only if it also led on 2022-2026.

results.bias: Companies listed today only; compared with other companies that reported in the same window, not with the whole exchange.

reaction.what: Ranked on how the stock moved, against the average stock, on the day its results reached the exchange.

reaction_and_growth.what: Half the result-day move, half year-on-year profit growth.

reaction_and_growth_in_uptrend.what: The same, only stocks in an uptrend and outside the most volatile fifth.

growth.what: Ranked on year-on-year profit growth and revenue growth.

positive_reaction_in_uptrend.what: Rose more than the average stock on the day, in an uptrend. Ranked on the size of that move.

choice.rule: Taken only if it led the other reporting companies in both halves.
choice.why: Of those that passed, the result-day move held about a month is the simplest (one measurement, and it needs only the date of the filing), its lead was the steadiest and it was the same size in both halves. That choice among the ones that passed was made after seeing them.
